title: Where each hook policy evaluates
note: Every chain policy has one home: client, server, or server with named client facts. On HTTPS the client runs client-home policies and ships the facts the server-run policies read; in-process evaluation collects the same facts, so a verdict does not depend on install mode. A guard test fails on an unclassified local read in server-run code. Source/unit evidence is not deployed harness proof.
